scenes.title: Interview télévisée de Virginie et Ramzy
scenes.summary: Virginie Efira and Ramzy Bedia participate in a TV interview, projecting the image of a perfect couple and boasting about their equal pay.

scenes.title: L'appel nocturne de Virginie
scenes.summary: Mathias's meditation is interrupted by a frantic call from Virginie, who reveals she has been caught kissing another man by paparazzi.

scenes.title: Matin agité à l'agence ASK
scenes.summary: The agents arrive at work and discover the tabloid magazine revealing Virginie's infidelity, creating immediate panic.

scenes.title: Mathias et Camille au café
scenes.summary: Mathias meets Camille and suggests revealing their father-daughter relationship to the agency, but she is terrified of losing her friends and her job.

scenes.title: Arlette surprend Bréhier
scenes.summary: Arlette spots François Bréhier at a restaurant with Hélène Kerr, raising suspicions about his intentions towards ASK.

scenes.title: Panique et rumeurs
scenes.summary: The team discusses the paparazzi photos of Virginie. Arlette shares her troubling sighting of Bréhier, fearing a hostile takeover.

scenes.title: Réunion de crise financière
scenes.summary: Mathias informs the partners that the agency is in dire financial straits due to a tax adjustment, proposing a temporary salary cut.

scenes.title: Ramzy refuse de voir Virginie
scenes.summary: Ramzy confronts Mathias about the photos. When Virginie arrives at the agency to talk, Ramzy stubbornly refuses to see her.

scenes.title: L'agent de façade
scenes.summary: Virginie is devastated after being kicked out by Ramzy. Mathias and Gabriel propose that Gabriel act as her temporary agent to manage the crisis.

scenes.title: Ramzy boycotte la promotion
scenes.summary: In the elevator, Mathias tries to persuade Ramzy to participate in the film's promotional events, but Ramzy adamantly refuses.

scenes.title: Andréa prépare son voyage
scenes.summary: Andréa complains to her assistant about having to travel to her depressing hometown of Couchey for her mother's medal ceremony.

scenes.title: Une promotion désastreuse
scenes.summary: Mathias lies to journalists about Ramzy having a rare disease to excuse his absence, while Gabriel struggles to manage a deeply depressed Virginie during interviews.

scenes.title: La manipulation de Mathias
scenes.summary: Gabriel confronts Mathias, realizing that Mathias deliberately passed Virginie to him to avoid taking the blame if the situation explodes.

scenes.title: Retrouvailles à Couchey
scenes.summary: In Couchey, Andréa attends the medal ceremony and unexpectedly reconnects with her childhood classmate, Hicham Janowski, now a young millionaire.

scenes.title: L'ultimatum du producteur
scenes.summary: The film's angry producer calls Mathias, threatening to sue for breach of contract if Ramzy does not appear on Michel Drucker's television show.

scenes.title: Trêve entre Gabriel et Mathias
scenes.summary: Gabriel asks Mathias for genuine help with Virginie. Mathias agrees, noting that his separation from his wife has temporarily made him more human.

scenes.title: Bréhier menace Arlette
scenes.summary: While walking her dog, Arlette is approached by François Bréhier, who explicitly threatens to expose old agency secrets if ASK doesn't surrender.

scenes.title: L'idée lumineuse d'Andréa
scenes.summary: Learning that Hicham just sold his company for millions, Andréa realizes he could save the agency and rushes to catch him before he leaves.

scenes.title: Andréa fait sa proposition
scenes.summary: During the drive, Andréa and Hicham reminisce about their youth. She pitches ASK to him, suggesting he become their new partner.

scenes.title: Le caprice d'Hicham
scenes.summary: On a film set, Hicham offers his car for a scene but throws a tantrum and storms off when the crew refuses to cast his cousin as the driver.

scenes.title: Virginie demande l'asile
scenes.summary: Virginie shows up at the agency, desperate because paparazzi are harassing her sister's family, and begs Gabriel to let her sleep at his place.

scenes.title: Soirée confidences
scenes.summary: At Gabriel's apartment, Virginie expresses her deep regret for hurting Ramzy, before angrily screaming at the paparazzi gathered outside.

scenes.title: Réveil chez Gabriel
scenes.summary: The next morning, Gabriel and Virginie joke around playfully. Virginie pretends to coach Gabriel for an acting career to help him if the agency sinks.

scenes.title: La décision de Catherine
scenes.summary: Mathias meets his wife Catherine, hoping for a reconciliation, but she tells him she can no longer trust him and asks for a divorce.

scenes.title: La trahison dévoilée
scenes.summary: Gabriel meets with Ramzy and reveals that Mathias manipulated him with a secret contract so he would earn significantly more than Virginie.

scenes.title: Ramzy sur le plateau télé
scenes.summary: Ramzy appears on Michel Drucker's television show, interacting with the host and Arlette's dog, before a surprise guest is announced.

scenes.title: Règlement de comptes en direct
scenes.summary: Virginie makes a surprise appearance on the show. They argue live on air about the secret contract before transforming it into a passionate reconciliation.

scenes.title: Le départ pour StarMedia
scenes.summary: Back at the agency, Virginie and Ramzy confront Mathias, return his gift, and announce they are leaving ASK for StarMedia because of his lies.

scenes.title: Le nouvel associé
scenes.summary: Hicham Janowski arrives at the agency and is introduced by Andréa as their new partner. The shock is so intense that Mathias faints on the spot.
